slices.title: Frame the arena (camera, aspect, framing)
slices.feelIntent: Establish the static one-screen arena frame so every later slice composes inside it.

slices.title: Player controller + move
slices.feelIntent: Responsive top-down/twin-stick movement at the contract moveSpeed; no input lag.

slices.title: Weapon core: fire -> projectile + impact
slices.feelIntent: Firing spawns a visible projectile with a crisp cadence and travel speed (fireIntervalMs / projectileSpeed / fireInputToSpawnLatency are measure-only).

slices.title: Enemy + health/damage + death
slices.feelIntent: Reference enemy takes damage and dies; first-hit to death (ttkMs) is measure-only.

slices.title: Combat feedback (muzzle / hit-spark / shake / hit-stop)
slices.feelIntent: Fire and impact read clearly through muzzle flash, hit spark, screen shake, and a brief hit-stop.

slices.title: HUD (score / ammo / health)
slices.feelIntent: Score, ammo, and health read clearly and stay inside the safe area.

slices.title: Defeat / victory end-state
slices.feelIntent: Clearing the arena (all enemies defeated) shows a clean win/end state.
